1.consolidated_definition: Elaenia martinica riisii. Se mantiene de frutitas y no de insectos; es pardo por encima, de alas oscuras con orillas blancas, garganta gris, vientre verde tenue y blanco, y mide seis y media pulgadas. Habita en las Islas de Culebra y Vieques y cayos cercanos, sin que frecuente el territorio de Puerto Rico.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Martinica Riis's Elaenia. It is maintained by fruit and not insects; it is brown above, with dark wings and white edges, a gray throat, a pale green and white belly, and measures six and a half inches in length. It inhabits the islands of Culebra and Vieques and nearby cays, without frequently inhabiting the territory of Puerto Rico.
